strategy.offer: Customized industrial coding, marking, identification and labeling systems, plus integration, consumables, training and service for direct product and packaging marking.
strategy.customers: Manufacturers, machine builders and logistics operators across industries needing reliable, contact-free marking, compliance, identification and traceability on varied products, packaging and surfaces.
strategy.why_we_win: It expects to win through one-stop customized solutions, robust low-maintenance technologies, common operation across systems, certified quality, and global support for harsh environments.
strategy.resources: Its basis is in-house development, production, assembly, service and sales, broad technology and ink expertise, over 400 employees, and distributors in more than 50 countries.
strategy.direction: It is heading toward broader digitalization, serialization and end-to-end traceability across production chains while further expanding its worldwide sales and service network.
